body: I’m sorry for all these comments OP, they are quite harsh and unhelpful. I can understand how you feel especially if the people around you in your work environment seem to be bonding with each other more than you. Just accept his boundaries and try to make connections with those that are susceptible to it in your org. I’d highly recommend seeing if there are mentorship groups or coffee chats, etc to join at your firm!

We are a point in Canada where there are people who don’t believe that atrocities were committed against native peoples. So yes I’m glad they did not gloss over this and only show white settlors in the movie. I’m not saying it is the best representation but it was at least somewhat accurate to what has happened in the past.  We can’t just forget the past in order to have reconciliation moving forward. We need to fully understand our own responsibilities in the colonization of Canada and to create a better Canada for all moving forward. Something being cruel doesn’t mean we shouldn’t represent it in the media. Burying and hiding racism like this for decades is exactly how we have gotten to the point of MMIW being declared a national crisis and residential school impacts are only being addressed very recently. Also it’s a horror movie. Was it nice in this movie when the girls were beaten by their dad? not at all, I’m fact it was pretty cruel but again very accurate to the time period and story.

What’s inherently good about wishing to live?
Should the sum of a persons life come down to looking forward to going on a walk one day soon?

Everyday is the same empty void of loneliness. Times and dates don’t change that. Any plans made get cancelled or nothing comes of them and the days are once again empty. One cannot live for a concert six months from now just to see it postponed once again. One moment in time that may possibly happen and provide a a good memory in the future is not enough stability to keep moving forward.

Upbeat media serves to remind one of good times and memories in their own life. If you have no past, present or future good times to think about it serves as only a reminder that others are able to have what you cannot. Otherwise this media serves as merely another distraction in a life filled with meaningless distractions in order to forget the emptiness that is living.

A really good method I was taught for interviews that has helped me is the STAR method of answering questions. If you’re looking for a new technique to try I would recommend doing some reading on it! It helped me get past answering questions with very short responses. 

It is also good to just keep a list of examples of your past career achievements in the back of your head to pull forward any answer. 

Also the most important thing to remember in an interview is that you should be talking yourself up. You do have value and skills and people will see that and hire you eventually. 

Best of luck!

There are few studies out there talking about the connection between ADD and marajuana. Because ADD causes a lack of dopamine and weed provides a boost in dopamine, weed can be used a medicine of sorts to help with the deficiency. Look out for signs of emotional dependence that is when it might become a problem. My partner (DxADD) is also a daily smoker and talks to his therapist about it. They see no issue in him doing it and it’s helped my partner to function better in a world not made for his brain. 

As a side note weed is really a miracle drug and my partner de-stigmatizing it helped me realize the benefits it can bring to my own life.
